name: Cain Macreel
source:
The protagonist's younger brother and next king of his country.
He's actually a secret clone made by [url=/c54025]Sieg[/url] of the real Cain, but he doesn't know that himself.
He doesn't have the past memories of the real prince, so he's studying hard in order to become the next king.
